overloads.semanticRole: The USE ENTITY SELECTION command updates the current selection of the table matching the dataclass of the entitySelection parameter, according to the content of the entity selection.

constraints: Cannot be used with a Remote datastore.
In 4D single-user and 4D Server, entitySelection is directly connected to the resulting current selection for performance; once used, entitySelection must not be reused or altered afterwards.
After the call, the first record of the updated current selection (if any) becomes the current record but is not loaded into memory; use LOAD RECORD afterwards if field values are needed.
